turn.content: The PO price is 1,520,100 and the invoice bills 1,744,900. The contract fixes unit prices in Schedule A (clause 2.1) and only allows changes via written addendum (2.2). Nothing indicates an addendum or a future effective price, so this is an overcharge.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0272", "detail": "PO line 1 sets Cat6 Network Cable (box) unit price at 1520100 for quantity 2."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "0229/PSG/IX/2026", "detail": "Invoice line 1 bills unit price 1744900, above the PO price."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-032#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of the Agreement."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-032#2.2", "detail": "A price change takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively."}], "explanation": "The invoice bills 1,744,900 per unit against an unchanged PO price of 1,520,100, and the contract contains no addendum or future-dated price authorizing the higher amount, so the unit price is an overcharge."}]}
